message.content: Good morning. I need your help with something that has been bothering me for weeks. I want to set up video calls with my grandson in Toronto, but I haven't sorted it out yet. He lives there now, and I miss seeing his face.

content.text: Good morning, Krzysztof. I understand how important that is. Let's get this done today. Does your grandson use WhatsApp for calls, or is there another app he prefers?

message.content: It's WhatsApp. I have the app on my old tablet, but I can't remember how to start a video call from there. I always end up just sending text messages, which isn't the same.

content.text: That's very common. Let's walk through it together. First, open the WhatsApp application on your tablet. Then, tap on the 'Chats' tab at the bottom right corner.

message.content: Okay, I'm in. I see the list of my contacts. I need to find his name. What comes next?

content.text: Scroll down or use the search bar at the top to find his name. Once you tap on his name to open the chat window, look at the top right corner of the screen. You should see a small icon that looks like a video camera.

message.content: I see it. It's gray. Do I just tap it?

content.text: Yes, go ahead and tap that video camera icon. It will ask for permission to use your camera and microphone if you haven't allowed them before. Please allow both so he can see and hear you clearly.

message.content: Done. It's connecting now. The screen is black for a second, and then I see his face! He's waving. Oh, this is wonderful. Thank you, AI.
